title: HiringNow
lede: HiringNow is a job-search agent that watches employer career pages directly, rewrites your application documents for each role and submits them on the company's own site once you sign off.

points: Polls more than 247,000 company career sites every five minutes, aiming to surface roles before they reach LinkedIn or Indeed.
Matches each opening against your skills, experience, location and stated preferences.
Adapts your resume and drafts a cover letter per job, built from your real work history.
Nothing goes out without your approval, and every submission is logged with a receipt in a job tracker.
Also bundles a resume builder and mock interview practice.

sections.text: Active job seekers who want to apply early to fresh openings without hand-tailoring every resume and cover letter.
The team says the free plan includes 10 auto-applies, and paid plans start at $29 a month.
